tagline: Zeiss Ikon折叠相机，1936 年发布
description: Zeiss Ikon于1936年推出的折叠相机。快门速度Cronos everset shutter (though not engraved with the name); 1/5 - 1/100 second, plus 'B' and 'T'. Cable release socket. No delayed action.。Sliding rails on bed, with radial lever. Scale in metres, from 1.1 m to infinity.。

specs.快门: Cronos everset shutter (though not engraved with the name); 1/5 - 1/100 second, plus 'B' and 'T'. Cable release socket. No delayed action.
specs.取景器: Folding frame finder and brilliant finder
specs.对焦: Sliding rails on bed, with radial lever. Scale in metres, from 1.1 m to infinity.
specs.尺寸: 112 x 62 x 36 mm (folded); depth when erected approx. 90 mm
specs.英文简介: The Bobette II is one of the Ernemann cameras that was continued in production after the merger that created Zeiss Ikon in 1926.
